name: Understanding what AI learned from biology
gist: Building foundation models trained on vast amounts of biological data—DNA, proteins, cellular images, brain signals—so researchers can adapt them to new questions.
explain: Over the last decade, biologists have sequenced the genomes of thousands of organisms, imaged millions of protein structures, recorded billions of DNA and RNA sequences, photographed millions of cells, and captured brain activity from thousands of subjects. This is raw material. What if we trained a model on all of that data, and it learned the deep patterns in how biology works? Then when a researcher has a new question — does this mutation cause disease, or will this protein fold correctly — they could ask the model instead of running expensive experiments from scratch.

The challenge is that biological data is messy, diverse, and often involves rare events. A mutation might occur in one person in a million. A protein might only fold correctly if three things happen in sequence. The data comes from different labs, different organisms, different measurement methods — so the patterns are noisy and contradictory. A model trained on all this data could pick up false patterns or memorize quirks of specific datasets. It also needs to transfer: a model trained on human proteins should say something useful about a mouse protein, even if it has never seen that exact sequence before.

This cluster builds and releases foundation models — large models trained on vast biological datasets — and explores what they learned. Some models are trained only on DNA sequences and learn to predict mutations or genetic disease. Others are trained on protein sequences and 3D structures and learn to predict function or engineering challenges. Still others combine vision and biology: trained on cell images to detect disease patterns, or on brain imaging to predict outcomes. The papers explore how to train these models so they do not just memorize, how to adapt them to new tasks with small amounts of data, and how to check whether the model is really learning biology or just picking up statistical artifacts.

papers.title: A Brain Graph Foundation Model: Pre-Training and Prompt-Tuning across Broad Atlases and Disorders
papers.contribution: Unified framework established on 27 neuroimaging datasets spanning 25 disorders, 2 atlas types, 8 parcellations, 25,000 subjects with strong generalization in few-shot and zero-shot settings.

papers.title: BioX-Bridge: Model Bridging for Unsupervised Cross-Modal Knowledge Transfer across Biosignals
papers.contribution: Enables unsupervised cross-modal knowledge transfer of biosignals with reduced computational overhead compared to knowledge distillation approaches.

papers.title: Breaking Scale Anchoring: Frequency Representation Learning for Accurate High-Resolution Inference from Low-Resolution Training
papers.contribution: FRL allows errors to decrease with resolution, significantly outperforming baselines within task and resolution range with modest computational overhead.

papers.title: CellDuality: Unlocking Biological Reasoning in LLMs with Self-Supervised RLVR
papers.contribution: CellDuality enables LLM agents for robust reasoning in single-cell biology through self-supervised feedback without verifiable rewards.

papers.title: Controlling Repetition in Protein Language Models
papers.contribution: Substantially lowers repetition while preserving AlphaFold confidence scores on ESM-3 and ProtGPT2, outperforming decoding penalties and other baselines across CATH, UniRef50, and SCOP datasets.

papers.title: Genomic Foundationless Models: Pretraining Does Not Promise Performance
papers.contribution: Character-token models match or exceed larger pretrained k-mer/BPE models on many tasks; GFMs fail to capture clinically relevant mutations, suggesting current pretraining provides modest, tokenizer-dependent improvements.

papers.title: HiMAE: Hierarchical Masked Autoencoders Discover Resolution-Specific Structure in Wearable Time Series
papers.contribution: HiMAE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art foundation models on benchmarks, is orders of magnitude smaller, and achieves sub-millisecond edge inference on smartwatch CPUs.

papers.title: Learning Brain Representation with Hierarchical Visual Embeddings
papers.contribution: The method achieves favorable balance between retrieval accuracy and reconstruction fidelity through hierarchical visual embedding alignment.

papers.title: Map as a Prompt: Learning Multi-Modal Spatial-Signal Foundation Models for Cross-scenario Wireless Localization
papers.contribution: SigMap achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple localization tasks with strong zero-shot generalization, significantly outperforming supervised and self-supervised baselines.

papers.title: Test-Time Adaptation without Source Data for Out-of-Domain Bioactivity Prediction
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms baselines under scaffold, protein, and assay-based OOD settings without access to source data.

papers.title: Towards All-Atom Foundation Models for Biomolecular Binding Affinity Prediction
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on protein-ligand, drug-target, protein-protein, and antibody-antigen interactions; identifies wet-lab validated affinity-enhancing mutations.

papers.title: A Cognitive Process-Inspired Architecture for Subject-Agnostic Brain Visual Decoding
papers.contribution: Sacrifices only 7% accuracy on unseen subjects while generating reconstructed videos in 10 seconds without retraining.

papers.title: A New Paradigm for Genome-wide DNA Methylation Prediction Without Methylation Input
papers.contribution: MethylProphet accurately infers methylation at unmeasured CpGs and generalizes to unseen samples, trained on ENCODE data spanning 1.6 billion CpG-sample pairs.

papers.title: A Resolution-Agnostic Geometric Transformer for Chromosome Modeling Using Inertial Frame
papers.contribution: Achieves superior performance across four resolutions and improves functional analysis tasks, with cross-resolution transfer learning yielding up to 5% improvement from low to high resolution.

papers.title: A foundation model with multi-variate parallel attention to generate neuronal activity
papers.contribution: MVPFormer foundation model surpasses state-of-the-art on seizure detection and achieves expert-level performance on four Brain TreeBank iEEG decoding tasks (volume, pitch, onset, speech).

papers.title: A robust PPG foundation model using multimodal physiological supervision
papers.contribution: Pretrained on 3× fewer subjects; achieves performance improvements on 14 of 15 downstream tasks including field-like data with enhanced robustness.

papers.title: Adaptive DNA Sequence Modeling via Synergistic Plasticity Units
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on DNA modeling with quasi-linear complexity and provides theoretical analysis supporting the unified design paradigm.

papers.title: Adaptive Protein Tokenization
papers.contribution: Matches or outperforms existing models on reconstruction and generative tasks, enables zero-shot protein shrinking and affinity maturation, and outperforms other tokenizers on CATH classification.

papers.title: Adaptive Test-Time Training for Predicting Need for Invasive Mechanical Ventilation in Multi-Center Cohorts
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive performance on multi-center adaptation benchmarks while maintaining clinically meaningful patient representations.

papers.title: AntigenLM: Structure-Aware DNA Language Modeling for Influenza
papers.contribution: AntigenLM accurately forecasts future antigenic variants across regions and subtypes while outperforming phylogenetic models, demonstrating that preserving genomic structure is critical for DNA language models.

papers.title: Are EEG Foundation Models Worth It? Comparative Evaluation with Traditional Decoders in Diverse BCI Tasks
papers.contribution: Shows fine-tuned foundation models often fail to significantly outperform classical decoders in data-scarce settings, exposing gap between pre-training and downstream fine-tuning.

papers.title: Bimodal masked language modeling for bulk RNA-seq and DNA methylation representation learning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art cancer-type classification and survival prediction, and maintains downstream performance despite missing modalities.

papers.title: BioToken and BioFM – Biologically-Informed Tokenization Enables Accurate and Efficient Genomic Foundation Models
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art models on pathogenicity and expression prediction while requiring 100-fold less compute than large-scale genomic models.

papers.title: CDBridge: A Cross-omics Post-training Bridge Strategy for Context-aware Biological Modeling
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms prior methods on GTEx-Benchmark, capturing long-range exon dependencies and resolving isoform reuse for tissue-specific expression prediction.

papers.title: CONTEXTOR: Contextualized High-order Contrastive Learning
papers.contribution: CONTEXTOR consistently outperforms existing methods on benchmark datasets across diverse biomedical tasks.

papers.title: CalM: A Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Population Dynamics in Calcium Imaging Data
papers.contribution: CalM outperforms specialized baselines on neural population dynamics forecasting after pretraining and achieves superior behavior decoding results. Linear analyses reveal interpretable functional structures beyond predictive accuracy.

papers.title: ChaosNexus: A Foundation Model for ODE-based Chaotic System Forecasting with Hierarchical Multi-scale Awareness
papers.contribution: Achieves superior fidelity in long-term attractor statistics while maintaining competitive point-wise accuracy; zero-shot weather forecasting achieves mean error below 1°C for 5-day predictions.

papers.title: Cross-Subject Modeling for Widefield Calcium Imaging via Atlas-Aligned Spatiotemporal Tokenization
papers.contribution: WiCAT outperforms single-session models, enables zero-shot behavior decoding on unseen subjects, and achieves robust left-out brain region reconstruction.

papers.title: DIYHealth Suite: Dataset, Model, and Benchmark for Health Management at Home
papers.contribution: DIYHealthGPT delivers state-of-the-art performance on 11 home care tasks outperforming general-purpose and medical-specific baselines.

papers.title: DNACHUNKER: Learnable Tokenization for DNA Language Models
papers.contribution: Consistently improves over fixed-tokenization baselines on five benchmarks with learned segmentation that is mutation-resilient and biologically-informed.

papers.title: Decoding Dynamic Visual Experience from Calcium Imaging via Cell-Pattern-Aware SSL
papers.contribution: Yields 12-13% relative gains over from-scratch training with smooth monotonic scaling on Allen Brain Observatory; exhibits no plateau as model size increases.

papers.title: Decoding Inner Speech with an End-to-End Brain-to-Text Neural Interface
papers.contribution: BIT reduces word error rate from 24.69% to 10.22% on the Brain-to-Text benchmark and enables cross-task generalization between attempted and imagined speech.

papers.title: Distilling and Adapting: A Topology-Aware Framework for Zero-Shot Interaction Prediction in Multiplex Biological Networks
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art on multiplex biological network interaction prediction.

papers.title: Drugging the Undruggable: Benchmarking and Modeling Fragment-Based Screening
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms baselines including docking software, with retrieved fragments expandable into larger compounds with improved binding affinity.

papers.title: Explicitly Modeling Censoring Produces Superior Survival Predictors
papers.contribution: Consistent gains over baselines on 10 datasets (2 semi-synthetic, 8 real-world) across 4 popular deep-learning survival models.

papers.title: FM4NPP: A Scaling Foundation Model for Nuclear and Particle Physics
papers.contribution: With frozen weights and adapters, the FM consistently outperforms baseline models across all downstream tasks with robust data-efficient adaptation.

papers.title: FlexProtein: Joint Sequence and Structure Pretraining for Protein Modeling
papers.contribution: Establishes state-of-the-art on 12 tasks with particularly strong gains in mutation-rich settings where MSA-based methods struggle.

papers.title: GRAM-DTI: Adaptive Multimodal Representation Learning for Drug–Target Interaction Prediction
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on four public datasets, highlighting benefits of higher-order multimodal alignment and adaptive modality utilization.

papers.title: Genome-Factory: A Library for Tuning, Deploying, and Interpreting Genomic Foundation Models
papers.contribution: Demonstrates compatibility with diverse models and fine-tuning methods, validates utility through downstream benchmarking and biological interpretation.

papers.title: Greater than the Sum of Its Parts: Building Substructure into Protein Encoding Models
papers.contribution: Substructure-tuning improves function-related tasks while revealing complementarity between substructural and global structural information across state-of-the-art models.

papers.title: Harnessing Spectrum Video for Subject-Level Few-Shot and Cross-Montage EEG Generalization
papers.contribution: By utilizing VideoMAE for self-supervised pre-training, BSR learns robust, layout-agnostic spatiotemporal representations that preserve neural topology.

papers.title: Joint Adaptation of Uni-modal Foundation Models for Multi-modal Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms prior methods on AD diagnosis and progression prediction across four modalities (sMRI, fMRI, clinical records, genetic data).

papers.title: LDARNet: DNA Adaptive Representation Network with Learnable Tokenization for Genomic Modeling
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art on 5 histone modification tasks and wins 11/18 among compact models, with learned boundaries outperforming fixed-grid by up to 14 percentage points.

papers.title: Learning Cardiac Latent Representations in Vectorcardiogram Space
papers.contribution: Outperforms ECG-space baselines on various tasks with enhanced robustness and generalization, especially under domain shift.

papers.title: Learning Compressed Shape-Aware Molecular Representations for Virtual Screening
papers.contribution: Enables searching over 10 billion molecules in <1 second on single GPU—>10^8x speedup vs traditional methods—with representations strongly correlating shape overlap (R=0.86).

papers.title: Learning General Causal Structures with Hidden Dynamic Process for Climate Analysis
papers.contribution: Establishes identifiability conditions for both hidden dynamic processes and causal structure among observed variables even in nonparametric setting, with real-world experiments recovering causal graphs aligned with domain expertise.

papers.title: Learning Molecular Chirality via Chiral Determinant Kernels
papers.contribution: Achieves substantial improvements on R/S classification, enantiomer ranking, ECD, and OR prediction tasks, yielding over 7% higher accuracy on axially chiral tasks.

papers.title: Leveraging Lineage Barcodes as Natural Augmentations for Contrastive Learning of Cell Fate in scRNA-seq Data
papers.contribution: LCL predicts future cell-type compositions from early time points and significantly outperforms standard models like scVI on hematopoietic and fibroblast systems, establishing contrastive learning as a scalable paradigm for understanding cellular differentiati

papers.title: Lost in Tokenization: Context as the Key to Unlocking Biomolecular Understanding in Scientific LLMs
papers.contribution: Context-only input consistently outperforms sequence-only and combined input modes on biological reasoning tasks, with raw sequences acting as informational noise.

papers.title: M-IDoL: Information Decomposition for Modality-Specific and Diverse Representation Learning in Medical Foundation Model
papers.contribution: M-IDoL outperforms 20 foundation models on 21 downstream clinical tasks across five imaging modalities with clearer feature cluster separation.

papers.title: MEG-XL: Data-Efficient Brain-to-Text via Long-Context Pre-Training
papers.contribution: MEG-XL matches supervised performance with a fraction of the training data (e.g., 1hr vs 50hrs) and outperforms brain foundation models on data-efficient word decoding.

papers.title: MeshTok: Efficient Multi-Scale Tokenization for Scalable PDE Transformers
papers.contribution: Consistently improves efficiency-accuracy trade-off compared to uniform grids across multiple PDE families.

papers.title: MetaPerch: Learning from metadata for bioacoustics foundation models
papers.contribution: Auxiliary metadata losses encourage richer, more robust representations that generalize better to species distribution and acoustic domain shifts across 17 bioacoustic datasets.

papers.title: Modeling the Density of Pixel-level Self-supervised Embeddings for Unsupervised Pathology Segmentation in Medical CT
papers.contribution: Outperforms existing unsupervised methods on four large-scale test datasets (1,820 scans with diverse pathologies) and surpasses existing self-supervised pretraining in low-shot fine-tuning.

papers.title: Multifidelity Simulation-based Inference for Computationally Expensive Simulators
papers.contribution: Requires up to two orders of magnitude fewer high-fidelity simulations than current methods while showing comparable performance on benchmarks and neuroscience tasks.

papers.title: NeuroCLUS: A Foundation Model with Functional Clustering for Intracranial Neural Decoding
papers.contribution: Consistently achieves state-of-the-art across diverse decoding paradigms (speech perception/production, seizure detection); discovered clusters align with neurophysiology offering enhanced interpretability.

papers.title: OSF: On Pre-training and Scaling of Sleep Foundation Models
papers.contribution: OSF family of sleep FMs achieves state-of-the-art performance across nine datasets on diverse sleep and disease prediction tasks with improved sample efficiency and cross-dataset scaling.

papers.title: Omni-fMRI: A Universal Atlas-Free fMRI Foundation Model
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms existing foundation models with atlas-free approach, providing scalable and reproducible framework for voxel-level brain representation learning.

papers.title: OmniMouse: Scaling properties of multi-modal, multi-task Brain Models on 150B Neural Tokens
papers.contribution: Performance scales reliably with more data but saturates with model size, showing brain models are data-limited despite vast recordings, inverting the standard AI scaling story.

papers.title: PatchDNA: A Flexible and Biologically-Informed Alternative to Tokenization for DNA
papers.contribution: Models an order of magnitude smaller surpass state-of-the-art on DNA benchmarks with flexibility to change patching without retraining, overcoming tokenization limitations.

papers.title: Probabilistic Retrofitting of Learned Simulators
papers.contribution: Achieves 20–54% reductions in rollout CRPS and up to 30% improvements in variance-normalized RMSE on single-system models, and 40% improvement in CRPS on PDE foundation models, with modest additional training cost.

papers.title: Protein Fold Classification at Scale: Benchmarking and Pretraining
papers.contribution: MiAE scales well and outperforms supervised counterparts and baselines on TEDBench, establishing a strong recipe for protein fold classification.

papers.title: Protein Structure Tokenization via Geometric Byte Pair Encoding
papers.contribution: Achieves >10x compression with consistent 1.0-1.1 test/train distortion ratio and outperforms leading tokenizers across 12 tasks and 24 test splits.

papers.title: RECTOR: Masked Region-Channel-Temporal Modeling for Affective and Cognitive Representation Learning
papers.contribution: Sets state-of-the-art in EEG emotion recognition and sEEG task-engagement classification with strong robustness to missing channels and cross-montage generalization.

papers.title: RealPDEBench: A Benchmark for Complex Physical Systems with Real-World Data
papers.contribution: Reveals significant discrepancies between simulated and real-world data; pretraining with simulated data consistently improves both accuracy and convergence, advancing sim-to-real transfer.

papers.title: Representing local protein environments with machine learning force fields
papers.contribution: MLFF embeddings enable zero-shot generalization and achieve state-of-the-art accuracy on biomolecular NMR spectroscopy tasks, establishing MLFFs as general-purpose representation learners for protein modeling.

papers.title: Riemannian High-Order Pooling for Brain Foundation Models
papers.contribution: RHOP improves EEG classification accuracy, robustness, and efficiency across diverse benchmarks as a plug-and-play module compatible with modern foundation models like BIOT and LaBraM.

papers.title: SGERA: Stein-Guided ECG-Report Alignment for ECG Representation Learning
papers.contribution: To address this, we propose **SGERA** (**S**tein-**G**uided **E**CG-**R**eport **A**lignment), which leverages the unique properties of Stein kernels to provide a more rigorous geometric alignment in the latent space: **instance-level** alignment via a Stein-R

papers.title: SI-IGCL: Subject Invariance-aware Inverse Graph Contrastive Learning for Psychiatric Disorder Identification
papers.contribution: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms all state-of-the-art methods

papers.title: SLAE: Strictly Local All-atom Environment for Protein Representation
papers.contribution: Reconstructs all-atom structures with high fidelity and achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse downstream tasks with chemically informative latent space.

papers.title: STT-LLM: Structural-Temporal Tokenization for Adapting LLMs to Longitudinal Clinical Profiles
papers.contribution: Demonstrates consistent improvements over native LLM tokenization in sequence prediction and anomaly detection on real-world longitudinal sports-doping datasets with contextual reasoning aligned to expert assessments.

papers.title: Scaling Vision Transformers for Functional MRI with Flat Maps
papers.contribution: Observes strict power law scaling for fMRI, demonstrates CortexMAE outperforms prior models on cognitive state decoding by large margin though null results on trait prediction versus functional connectivity baseline.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Evolution Operator Learning for High-Dimensional Dynamical Systems
papers.contribution: Provides effective data-driven tool for understanding complex natural phenomena and extracting patterns from large-scale scientific datasets.

papers.title: SleepLM: Natural-Language Intelligence for Human Sleep
papers.contribution: SleepLM outperforms state-of-the-art on zero-shot and few-shot learning, cross-modal retrieval, and exhibits language-guided event localization and targeted insight generation.

papers.title: SleepMaMi: A Universal Sleep Foundation Model for Integrating Macro- and Micro-structures
papers.contribution: Trained on over 20,000 PSG recordings (158K hours), outperforms or matches existing foundation models across diverse downstream tasks with superior generalizability.

papers.title: SynerMedGen: Synergizing Medical Multimodal Understanding with Generation via Task Alignment
papers.contribution: Achieves strong zero-shot performance on 22 medical image synthesis tasks and outperforms specialized and recent unified models with generation training, while releasing SynerMed dataset with 1M synthesis samples and 2M understanding instances.

papers.title: Task-Adaptive Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Weather Foundation Models
papers.contribution: WeatherPEFT achieves performance parity with Full-Tuning using fewer trainable parameters across three downstream weather tasks.

papers.title: Tokenizing Single-Channel EEG with Time-Frequency Motif Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 11% improvement in Cohen's Kappa on diverse benchmarks, consistently boosts diverse foundation models, and generalizes across device types and signal formats.

papers.title: Towards Universal Gene Regulatory Network Inference: Unlocking Generalizable Regulatory Knowledge in Single-cell Foundation Models
papers.contribution: Our approach significantly outperforms existing methods in zero-shot GRN inference on unseen genes and datasets, establishing a new paradigm for leveraging foundation models.

papers.title: TriForces: Augmenting Atomistic GNNs for Transferable Representations
papers.contribution: Reduces energy MAE by 57% on OMat24 at 20K samples only and improves force MAE across sizes; enables efficient similar structure retrieval through learned latent space.

papers.title: Uni-NTFM: A Unified Foundation Model for EEG Signal Representation Learning
papers.contribution: Uni-NTFM outperforms existing EEG models across nine distinct benchmarks after pretraining on 28,000 hours of EEG data.

papers.title: ViEEG: Hierarchical Visual Neural Representation for EEG Brain Decoding
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms previous methods on THINGS-EEG and THINGS-MEG datasets in both subject-dependent and subject-independent settings; enables zero-shot object recognition.

papers.title: Walrus: A Cross-domain Foundation Model for Continuum Dynamics
papers.contribution: Walrus outperforms prior foundation models on short- and long-term prediction horizons across diverse physical domains (astrophysics, geoscience, rheology, plasma physics, acoustics, fluids).

papers.title: dnaHNet: A Scalable and Hierarchical Foundation Model for Genomic Sequence Learning
papers.contribution: dnaHNet achieves superior performance on zero-shot protein variant fitness and gene essentiality prediction with >3× inference speedup over Transformers and quadratic FLOP reductions.

papers.title: scDEBART: Predicting in silico Single-Cell Perturbation Responses via Large-Scale Differential Expression Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves 11.96 mean enrichment factor (4-7x higher than competitors), 71.4% top-1 accuracy for reverse identification, and dose-dependent improvement in cross-modal transfer.
